ideas.title: Biggest Minnesota Fraud Scandal Yet: $9B at Risk
ideas.description: Investigate the Minnesota officials' handling of social program funds and the potential losses due to inaction on fraud warnings.
questions: What were the specific warnings ignored by Minnesota officials?
How did the inaction impact the state's social programs?
ideas.insight: The story would delve into the details of the U.S. House report and explore the implications of Minnesota officials' inaction on fraud warnings, potentially uncovering a significant scandal.
